backtest_requests_cancellation_reason_ch.name: backtest_requests_cancellation_reason_check
backtest_requests_cancellation_reason_ch.value: ("backtest_requests"."cancellation_reason_code" IS NULL OR "backtest_requests"."canceled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("backtest_requests"."cancellation_reason_text" IS NULL OR "backtest_requests"."canceled_at" IS NOT NULL)

case_manual_decisions_exclusion_check.name: case_manual_decisions_exclusion_check
case_manual_decisions_exclusion_check.value: ("case_manual_decisions"."kind" = 'exclude') = ("case_manual_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "case_manual_decisions"."reinstatement_reason" IS NULL AND "case_manual_decisions"."previous_status" = 'measured')

case_manual_decisions_reinstatement_chec.name: case_manual_decisions_reinstatement_check
case_manual_decisions_reinstatement_chec.value: ("case_manual_decisions"."kind" = 'reinstate') = ("case_manual_decisions"."reinstatement_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "case_manual_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS NULL AND "case_manual_decisions"."previous_status" = 'excluded')

case_manual_decisions_comment_check.name: case_manual_decisions_comment_check
case_manual_decisions_comment_check.value: "case_manual_decisions"."comment" IS NOT NULL OR ("case_manual_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other_confounding_factor' AND "case_manual_decisions"."reinstatement_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'criterion_unsuited_to_case')

cases_measurement_check.name: cases_measurement_check
cases_measurement_check.value: "cases"."status" NOT IN ('measured', 'excluded') OR ("cases"."measured_game_id", "cases"."performance_index", "cases"."baseline_season", "cases"."baseline_phase", "cases"."baseline_game_count", "cases"."baseline_mean", "cases"."baseline_standard_deviation", "cases"."baseline_status", "cases"."baseline_is_partial", "cases"."normalized_gap", "cases"."gap_status") IS NOT NULL

cases_game_reason_check.name: cases_game_reason_check
cases_game_reason_check.value: NOT ("cases"."status_reason" IN ('box_score_incomplete', 'box_score_suspect', 'box_score_unavailable', 'insufficient_baseline', 'derived_game_missed', 'baseline_building')) OR "cases"."measured_game_id" IS NOT NULL

event_corrections_values_check.name: event_corrections_values_check
event_corrections_values_check.value: "event_corrections"."field" NOT IN ('description', 'unverified_note', 'sources', 'article_detached', 'event_merged_in', 'player_added', 'rescued') OR ("event_corrections"."before_value" IS NULL AND "event_corrections"."after_value" IS NULL)

event_sources_publication_check.name: event_sources_publication_check
event_sources_publication_check.value: CASE WHEN "event_sources"."publication_precision" IS NULL THEN ("event_sources"."publication_at" IS NULL) = ("event_sources"."publication_offset_minutes" IS NULL) ELSE "event_sources"."publication_at" IS NOT NULL END

event_types_complete_sheet_check.name: event_types_complete_sheet_check
event_types_complete_sheet_check.value: "event_types"."status" NOT IN ('validated', 'withdrawn') OR ("event_types"."current_version_number", "event_types"."definition", "event_types"."inclusion_criteria", "event_types"."exclusion_criteria", "event_types"."dating_rule", "event_types"."generic_example", "event_types"."documentation_difficulty") IS NOT NULL

event_types_commented_rejection_check.name: event_types_commented_rejection_check
event_types_commented_rejection_check.value: "event_types"."rejection_comment" IS NULL OR "event_types"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL

event_types_merged_into_check.name: event_types_merged_into_check
event_types_merged_into_check.value: "event_types"."merged_into_type_id" IS NULL OR "event_types"."withdrawal_reason_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'merged_into'

event_types_entered_reason_check.name: event_types_entered_reason_check
event_types_entered_reason_check.value: ("event_types"."withdrawal_reason_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'entered') = ("event_types"."withdrawal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

events_historical_check.name: events_historical_check
events_historical_check.value: "events"."origin" <> 'historical' OR (("events"."reference_date_on", "events"."reference_date_precision", "events"."research_confidence", "events"."precedence", "events"."origin_import_id") IS NOT NULL AND ("events"."reference_at" IS NULL) = ("events"."reference_offset_minutes" IS NULL) AND "events"."reference_date_precision" = CASE WHEN "events"."reference_at" IS NULL THEN 'approximate' ELSE 'exact' END AND ("events"."detected_status", "events"."dismissal_reason", "events"."dismissal_comment", "events"."dismissed_at", "events"."detection_confidence", "events"."reference_date_rule", "events"."classification_origin", "events"."derived_game_id") IS NULL)

events_detected_check.name: events_detected_check
events_detected_check.value: "events"."origin" <> 'detected' OR (("events"."detected_status", "events"."reference_at", "events"."reference_date_precision", "events"."reference_date_rule", "events"."classification_origin") IS NOT NULL AND ("events"."reference_date_on", "events"."reference_offset_minutes", "events"."research_confidence", "events"."unverified_note", "events"."precedence", "events"."origin_import_id", "events"."derived_game_id") IS NULL)

events_calendar_check.name: events_calendar_check
events_calendar_check.value: "events"."origin" <> 'calendar' OR (("events"."derived_game_id", "events"."reference_date_on") IS NOT NULL AND ("events"."reference_at", "events"."reference_offset_minutes", "events"."reference_date_precision", "events"."type_link_mark", "events"."research_confidence", "events"."unverified_note", "events"."precedence", "events"."origin_import_id", "events"."detected_status", "events"."dismissal_reason", "events"."dismissal_comment", "events"."dismissed_at", "events"."detection_confidence", "events"."reference_date_rule", "events"."classification_origin") IS NULL)

events_dismissed_check.name: events_dismissed_check
events_dismissed_check.value: ("events"."detected_status" = 'dismissed') = ("events"."dismissal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."dismissed_at" IS NOT NULL)

fetch_queue_items_failing_since_check.name: fetch_queue_items_failing_since_check
fetch_queue_items_failing_since_check.value: ("fetch_queue_items"."wait_reason" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'outage') = ("fetch_queue_items"."failing_since" IS NOT NULL)

games_placeholder_check.name: games_placeholder_check
games_placeholder_check.value: ("games"."home_team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "games"."away_team_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "games"."status" = 'scheduled'

games_distinct_teams_check.name: games_distinct_teams_check
games_distinct_teams_check.value: "games"."home_team_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "games"."away_team_id" OR "games"."home_team_id" IS NULL

games_final_score_check.name: games_final_score_check
games_final_score_check.value: "games"."status" <> 'final' OR ("games"."home_score" IS NOT NULL AND "games"."away_score" IS NOT NULL)

general_trends_control_range_check.name: general_trends_control_range_check
general_trends_control_range_check.value: ("general_trends"."control_range_low" IS NULL) = ("general_trends"."control_mean_gap" IS NULL) AND ("general_trends"."control_range_high" IS NULL) = ("general_trends"."control_mean_gap" IS NULL)

import_event_outcomes_set_aside_check.name: import_event_outcomes_set_aside_check
import_event_outcomes_set_aside_check.value: ("import_event_outcomes"."outcome" IN ('ignored', 'refused')) = ("import_event_outcomes"."reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("import_event_outcomes"."outcome" IN ('ignored', 'refused')) = ("import_event_outcomes"."position" IS NOT NULL) AND ("import_event_outcomes"."outcome" NOT IN ('ignored', 'refused') OR "import_event_outcomes"."player_event_id" IS NULL)

incidents_quota_service_role_check.name: incidents_quota_service_role_check
incidents_quota_service_role_check.value: NOT ("incidents"."kind" IN ('quota_reached', 'quota_warning')) OR "incidents"."service_role" IS NOT NULL

mapping_candidates_first_season_check.name: mapping_candidates_first_season_check
mapping_candidates_first_season_check.value: CASE WHEN "mapping_candidates"."first_season" !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN false ELSE right("mapping_candidates"."first_season", 2)::integer = (left("mapping_candidates"."first_season", 4)::integer + 1) % 100 END

mapping_candidates_last_season_check.name: mapping_candidates_last_season_check
mapping_candidates_last_season_check.value: CASE WHEN "mapping_candidates"."last_season" !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN false ELSE right("mapping_candidates"."last_season", 2)::integer = (left("mapping_candidates"."last_season", 4)::integer + 1) % 100 END

outbox_facts_subject_check.name: outbox_facts_subject_check
outbox_facts_subject_check.value: ("outbox_facts"."backtest_request_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_to_do', 'backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."deadline_game_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."player_event_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('backtest_request_deadline_changed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."event_type_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('type_proposal_new')) AND ("outbox_facts"."incident_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('incident_opened', 'incident_closed')) AND ("outbox_facts"."lot2_subject_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("outbox_facts"."kind" IN ('alert_sheet_produced', 'alert_sheet_updated', 'tracked_result_ready'))

seasons_season_check.name: seasons_season_check
seasons_season_check.value: CASE WHEN "seasons"."season" !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN false ELSE right("seasons"."season", 2)::integer = (left("seasons"."season", 4)::integer + 1) % 100 END

sensitivity_profiles_control_range_check.name: sensitivity_profiles_control_range_check
sensitivity_profiles_control_range_check.value: ("sensitivity_profiles"."control_range_low" IS NULL) = ("sensitivity_profiles"."control_mean_gap" IS NULL) AND ("sensitivity_profiles"."control_range_high" IS NULL) = ("sensitivity_profiles"."control_mean_gap" IS NULL)

stats_source_mappings_established_check.name: stats_source_mappings_established_check
stats_source_mappings_established_check.value: ("stats_source_mappings"."status" = 'established') = ("stats_source_mappings"."source_player_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "stats_source_mappings"."established_at" IS NOT NULL)

tally_exits_deleted_check.name: tally_exits_deleted_check
tally_exits_deleted_check.value: ("tally_exits"."exit_reason" = 'deleted') = ("tally_exits"."deletion_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "tally_exits"."public_date_on" IS NOT NULL AND "tally_exits"."exited_at" IS NOT NULL)

tally_exits_deletion_detail_check.name: tally_exits_deletion_detail_check
tally_exits_deletion_detail_check.value: ("tally_exits"."deletion_detail" IS NOT NULL) = ("tally_exits"."deletion_reason" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'other')

task_runs_one_running_key.name: task_runs_one_running_key
task_runs_one_running_key.where: "task_runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."result" IS NULL

task_runs_waiting_check.name: task_runs_waiting_check
task_runs_waiting_check.value: "task_runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("task_runs"."trigger" = 'on_demand' AND "task_runs"."result" IS NULL)

task_runs_pass_check.name: task_runs_pass_check
task_runs_pass_check.value: "task_runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "task_runs"."pass_id" IS NOT NULL
